original_ai_output.title_zh: 警方调查贡贝州潘塔米车队遇袭事件
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 贡贝州警方证实，人民民主党州长候选人伊萨·潘塔米教授的车队在杰卡达法里地区遭疑似政治暴徒袭击。据报袭击中有人点燃篝火并破坏车辆挡风玻璃，事发时潘塔米刚乘包机抵达该州并受到大批支持者迎接。警方表示尚未逮捕任何人，调查仍在进行中。

key_facts.fact: 贡贝州警方证实潘塔米车队遭疑似政治暴徒袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Gombe State Police Command on Wednesday confirmed an attack on the convoy of the Peoples Democratic Party governorship candidate, Professor Isa Pantami, by suspected political thugs in the Jekadafari area of Gombe State.

key_facts.fact: 袭击据报涉及点燃篝火和破坏车辆挡风玻璃
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack, which reportedly involved the burning of bonfires and the destruction of vehicle windshields

key_facts.fact: 警方表示尚未逮捕任何人，调查仍在进行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: no arrests had been made, adding that investigations were ongoing to identify those responsible

uncertainties: 袭击者身份尚未确认，警方称正在调查
事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
